code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_number_one_decimal: set "answer" to the average rate of change as a number rounded to one decimal place

code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_reference_line_crossing_: set "annotation" to an array containing every pixel point [x,y] where the plotted graph passes through {reference_line_description}; use [] when there are none
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_turning_point_count: set "annotation" to an array containing every visible turning-point pixel point [x,y] where the graph changes from increasing to decreasing or decreasing to increasing; use [] when there are none
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_local_extremum_count: set "annotation" to an array containing every visible local {extremum_kind_adjective} pixel point [x,y]; use [] when there are none
